author: big_gooberfish
quote: God, this is so bad. Thankfully I played a friend's copy instead of buying it myself. The characters are so horrible. Jason is a monotone soy boy, and I can't stand the sound of that torta's voice. Even thinking about playing this game again makes me want to puke.

author: big_gooberfish
quote: Denuvo DRM? Requires an Ubisoft account to play single-player? Touting Yasuke as a full-fledged, unambiguous samurai? Horrible performance and tons of bugs on launch? Stunted voice acting with hilariously amateur actors? It's a failure by every possible metric.

author: big_gooberfish
quote: This game's biggest sin is not allowing offline LAN play. But even so, I was hoping to get a good gameplay experience, even if I am forced to chain myself to Activision's servers and let them watch every move I make in-game. Sadly, this was not the case. What a soulless, depressing shell ****. Everything about it makes it painfully clear that it's a product of a corporate grind, rather than something the makers were genuinely passionate and interested in making. Every minute of this tripe game was a chore. My only hope is that Activision was as bored watching me play as I was playing it.

author: big_gooberfish
quote:
I ignored the initial backlash and gave this game a chance. But I was blow away by how vapid and insulting the story is. What an absolute joke.

Well... At least now I know that revenge is bad, right? ಠ_ಠ
